tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rig 'dzin ratna gling pa'i gter kha phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi bsnyen bsgrub dmigs rim zin bris lags so// 202) dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nus la btud nas/ de yi bsgrub pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus bri/ dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas su mtshams bcad la/ 'bru yi tshom bu gcig mthar bcu yi bskor/ dbus su seng phur mtha' mar mchod gtor rigs/ ji ltar 'byor bshams skyabs sems sngon btang la/ stong nyid ngang las rang rig yi ge hūm̐/ mthing nag gcig gi rol rtsal cho 'phrul las/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gzhal yas bsrung gur bcas/ de dbus bdud bzhi pad nyir hūm̐ de babs/ 'od 'phros rgyal ba 203)mchod cing gdon chags bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs gyur bdag nyid dpal chen sku/ mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phyag drug gi/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang*/ g.yon gnyis me dpung che dang kha ṭam̐ ga 'og ma g.yas g.yon thal sbyar phur bu dril/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum dur khrod chas kyis brjid/ yum chen sngo skya utpal thod khrag bsnams/ gnyies med 'khril sbyor gar dgu'i nyams ldan pa'i/ dpral bar hūm̐ kar dpung g.yas rnam par rgyal/ dpung g.yon dbyug sngon mgrin 204)par rta mchog dpal/ thugs kar gshin rje lte gong bdud rtsi 'khyil/ lte bar mi g.yo brla g.yas 'dod pa'i rgyal/ brla g.yon khams sum gsang bar stobs po che/ kun kyang mthing nag g.yas g.yon dkar dmar zhal/ phyag drug 'og nyis phur 'dril gong ma bzhi/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing yum rnams kyang*/ mthing skra dril bu thod khrag 'dzin par bskyed/ kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs/ spyan drangs dbyer med thim zhing slar 'od 'phros/ rigs lngas dbang bskur dngos grub stsol lamadzad pa'i/ rigs lnga'i lha tshogs kun gyis dbu brgyan bsam/ bdag gi thugs dkar nyi stong rdo rje ni/

tshon gang lte bar hūm̐ mthing mtha' bskor du/ oṃ badzra ki li kī la ya sarba bighnan bam hūm̐ phaṭaḥbai ḍūr phreng ba lta bu 'khor dmigs bzla/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor seng phur bcas 205)pa la'ang*/ bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin bsgom bya zhing*/ bdag nyid thugs las 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi/ thugs ka'i sngags la phog pas de las 'od/ dpag med 'phros nas rgyal kun mthu nus rnams/ 'brum tshul du tshur bsdus bdag la thim/ mchog mthun dngos grub thob dmigs 'bru 'bum bzlas/ phyag mtshan rnyed dang 'phur dang gdon thul rtags/ sna tshogs 'char 'gyur zhen 'dzin med pa gnang*/ bsnyen them bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa 'di ltar bya/ bdag mdun dmigs rim gzhan kun gong bzhin las/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng zhal nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed zhal zhugs sku yi dbyibs rgyud nas/ lte ba nas 'thon bdag skyed lte bar zhugs/ dbyibs brgyud slar yang zhal nas gong bzhin brgyud/ de ltar 'gal med ltar bskor de las 'od/ phyir 206)'phros gdug pa tshar bcad phrin las bzhi/ thog med 'grub bsam de yis sngags 'di bzla/ oṃ badzra ki li ki la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho ka te ka te/ dza ye bi dza ye/ a tsi { a las dza dag par bshad/ }te a pa ra tsi to/ mā ra ye na pra ma rta na ye/ sarba bigha na bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bum mam khri'am gsum khri bsgrus nas 'grub/ de nas las sbyor dmigs pa 'di lta ste/ bdag nyid yab kyi zhal nas sngags phreng thon/ yum gyi zhal zhugs gsang ba'i padmo nas/ bdag gi gsang rdor sbub brgyud slar zhal 'thon/ de ltar 'khor dmigs 'od 'phros gong ltar las/ phrin las ji ltar 'dod pa 'grub dmigs shing*/ khri tshod gcig gis nges par 'grub par gsungs/ de ltar bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor thams cad kyi/ thun 'jog dus su bdag mdun lha tshogs kun/ bdag thugs hūm̐ la bsdu zhing de nyid kyang*/ dmigs med rgyas gdab slar yang

207)rgyud ldan gyi/ spyod lam kun tu lha yi nga rgyal bya/ dge kun 'gro la bsngo zhing sems skyed bsgom/ sgrub phur lus la 'bral med bcang bar bya/ de ltar 'di ni gsang bsgrub sor gzhag nyid/ go bder bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro kun shog ces pa 'di/ chos nyid la mos pa'i rnal 'byor shī la lha dras nan gyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o/ maṅga laṃ// 208)
